subject: revit

milestone.title: Editing tools
milestone.objective: Use Move, Copy, Rotate, Mirror and Align to fix a wall layout in 10 minutes

sources.title: Revit Help: Modify tools (fixture)
sources.text: The Modify panel on the Modify tab holds the main editing tools. Select elements first, then choose the tool. Move (keyboard shortcut MV): click a start point, then an end point, or type a distance. Copy (CO): works like Move but leaves the original in place; select Multiple in the Options Bar to place several copies. Rotate (RO): click to set the rotation angle start and end, or type an angle; drag the rotation centre to change the pivot. Mirror - Pick Axis (MM): click an existing line or edge to mirror about it; clear Copy in the Options Bar to move the original instead of copying it. Align (AL): first click the reference you want to align TO, then click the element to move.

lesson_lines: All these tools are on the Modify tab, Modify panel. Select the elements first, then pick the tool.
- **Move (MV):** click a start point and an end point, or type a distance.
- **Copy (CO):** like Move, but the original stays. Tick **Multiple** in the Options Bar to place several copies.
- **Rotate (RO):** click the start and end of the angle, or type it. Drag the rotation centre to change the pivot.
- **Mirror - Pick Axis (MM):** click an existing line or edge to mirror about. Clear **Copy** in the Options Bar if you want to flip the original instead of copying it.
- **Align (AL):** click the reference you want to align TO first, then the element that should move.
Open your wall layout and fix it: move one wall, copy a partition three times, rotate the porch walls 90°, mirror the bathroom and align the interior walls to the grid.
